scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run scan:style && npm run build
scripts.test: FILES=$(find app lib components tests \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null); COUNT=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -c .); if [ "$COUNT" -lt 162 ]; then echo "test discovery found only $COUNT test files, below the known floor of 162 — glob regression (WS7-011)" >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx --test $FILES
scripts.test:integration: FILES=$(find app lib tests -name '*.itest.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'); if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo 'no integration test files found' >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx --test $FILES
